explanation: The statement says that the left map of the library's own Mayer–Vietoris short complex, composed with `biprod.fst`, equals the inclusion map `mvInclUVU`. `mvShortComplex`, `mvLeftChainMap` and `mvInclUVU` are all defined in this library (`MayerVietorisSES.lean`) and are instantiated at `circU` and `circV`, which are also the library's own. The proof is just `simp` unfolding those definitions. Mathlib has no Mayer–Vietoris short complex of singular chains, so there is nothing to match. The only Mathlib lemma involved is a general `biprod.lift_fst`-style fact, and that isn't the content of this theorem. I did not search Mathlib directly beyond this reasoning. I only grepped the library to confirm where the definitions live.
